Gamma Retail Corp Q2 2026 Earnings Call

Operator: Good morning and welcome to the Gamma Retail Corp second quarter 2026 earnings call.

Carlos Mendez — Chief Executive Officer: Thank you all for joining. Comparable sales grew 6% versus last year, and total revenue was $240 million, up from $225 million a year ago.

Ellen Frost — Chief Financial Officer: Inventory turns improved to 5.2 times, and we are guiding full-year comparable sales growth of approximately 5%.

Operator: We will now begin the question-and-answer session.

Analyst One: How are inventory levels heading into the holiday season?

Carlos Mendez: Inventory levels remain elevated ahead of the holiday season, and we are actively managing markdowns to stay disciplined.
